name: Neuromeka Co., Ltd.
summary: Neuromeka Co., Ltd. manufactures industrial robots. It builds a Robot as a Service platform business ecosystem centered on collaborative robots. The company offers collaborative, industrial, mobile, embedded, and delta robots; smart actuators, robot controllers, accessories, teach pendants, and vision solutions, as well as robot software; standard tools; and robot platform and remote maintenance management services. It serves the manufacturing, F&B service, and media and art applications. Neuromeka Co., Ltd. was founded in 2013 and is based in Seoul, South Korea.
